Assist in review and validation of:
Payment applications
Change orders / equitable adjustments
Contractor correspondence

Confirm all actions align strictly with contract requirements rather than informal agreements.
Oversight of logs maintained by PMC:
RFIs
Submittals
Changes / NOCs

Support independent cost estimating and negotiation preparation (where required).

System Safety Certification process - Quality Management Plan; Environmental and regulatory requirements
Support audits, readiness reviews, and certification milestones.
Verify Design‑Builder adherence to approved procedures and standards.

Interface with:
MTA C&D leadership
NYCT operations (Service Delivery, OCC)
Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs)

Support preparation for executive-level briefings and decision forums.
Maintain clear and professional communication aligned with PMC’s role as owner’s representative.

Document Control & Reporting

Confirm all project documentation is: Properly tracked, reviewed, approved, and archived; Aligned with Document Control Plan requirements.
Oversee completeness of:
Submittals
Technical deliverables;
Close-out documentation

Support traceability across requirements, design, and testing artifacts.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering (electrical, systems, civil, mechanical, or related discipline), architecture, or Business Administration or Project Management or equivalent.

Preferably rail transportation and/or CBTC projects or projects that involve complex system integration. Experience with rail systems, signaling, CBTC, communications, or complex systems integration is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience supporting project management functions on multidisciplinary engineering projects.
Strong technical foundation with the ability to interface between engineering and project management.
Solid understanding of project delivery and lifecycle management.
Excellent coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, safety‑critical environment.
Proficient in project reporting tools, document control systems, and standard engineering software.
Exposure to AI and AI tools (such as AI agents) for Project Management / delivery of projects
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

With strategic office locations across the U.S. and more than three decades of design leadership, KTGY brings together architecture, interior design, branded environments and urban design to realize innovative concepts for how people live. Guided by our core values of design, collaboration, care and partnership our teams realize solutions that make a positive impact for our clients, communities, individuals and the environment. Project Manager - Architecture

Studio - Washington, D.C. High Density

Design innovators who lead with ideas, the passionate team members of D.C. High Density lend considerable experience and brainpower to the design of high rise, multifamily and mixed use developments. Navigating the challenges of affordable design and development is a particular focus for this studio, and they are always happy to share what they know with our other studios. Through their buddy system and regular office-wide lunches, D.C. HD focuses on uniting and coordinating everyone under a “one team, one dream” credo. Sharing an office with For Sale, Interior Design and Research + Development, getting all team members on the same page is a priority for this studio.

Your Impact

As KTGY's Project Manager is charged with bringing the project vision and story into reality. While the scale and complexity of the project may vary, the role of the project manager remains the same and embodies a combination of technical savvy, organizational skills, and design thinking to effectively, efficiently create the documents for realizing the built project. They coordinate between design teams, clients, and consultants, ensuring smooth communication and project flow, and successful execution of budgets, schedules, and quality control. Their expertise in building codes, construction methodologies, and industry standards is essential in translating design concepts into buildable structures.

Your Role

At KTGY, your career should be as thoughtfully designed as the spaces you create. We’re committed to nurturing passionate talent and guiding growth within the following four key aspects of our practice:

Design

Applies experience and knowledge to proactively solve design challenges. Orchestrates coordination efforts with consultants and challenges the team to always look for innovative solutions. Thinks creatively to execute the design vision and tell the project story through construction documents. Leads detailing efforts.

Collaboration

Works closely with Senior Designer or Designer to ensure the project vision and story is carried through to the built result. Sets project pace and rhythm. Empowers team members to fully utilize their strengths and grow in their competencies. Takes a proactive and systematic approach to QA/QC to ensure that the project deliverables meet the required quality standards. A successful project manager communicates with principals and studio leaders providing comprehensive updates on project progress, financials, and key decisions, seeking strategic input and guidance throughout the project lifecycle.

Care

Proactively seeks to understand the unique needs, perspectives, and aspirations of all stakeholders, including clients, end-users, and the project team. Cultivates a positive team culture that inspires trust, engagement, and a shared commitment to project success.

Partnership

Builds client confidence in KTGY. Anticipates client concerns and proactively communicates with clients to minimize negative project impacts. Engages clients in a collaborative problem-solving process when challenges arise, actively seeking their input and working together to find appropriate solutions that align with their goals and objectives.

Your Career

Explore | Focus| Manage

Project Manager is within Manage
, which entrusts team members with the supervision of projects and manage client relationships, internal and external, from start to finish. jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is actively seeking a creative, highly talented Aviation Design Project Manager for immediate employment for the Oakland, Orange, or Los Angeles, CA office.

Job Summary/Responsibilities

Performing a wide array of aviation-related civil design, planning, construction support, and client management services for General Aviation and Commercial Air Service Airports
Plan, direct, and monitor all aspects of small and large multi-discipline projects involving the design of airport engineering projects including runways, taxiways, aprons, vehicle service roads, airfield lighting and signage installation, navigational aids, drainage improvements, utility relocation and protection, and pavement rehabilitation
Mentor and develop staff, provide leadership and an environment that encourages teamwork, initiative and growth
Guide project teams on complex technical issues
Supervision, coordination, and production of several projects concurrently
Builds and maintains positive client relationships
Involved in marketing/business development including the ability to market and win work.
Develop strategy, prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and execute projects.
Coordinate staffing plan and workload through the entire project development duration while meeting project schedules and budgets
Control overall project cost and scope, schedule, and quality of work
Implement project QA/QC and work with Finance & Accounting, Controller, Department Manager, or Managing Principles for project reviews
Preparation of engineering design reports, project definition documents, construction plans, and contract documents / technical specifications
Significant design and construction oversight for multiple general aviation clients
Collaborating and/or coordinating design teams consisting of multi-discipline design engineers and technicians
Coordination with clients, funding agencies, FAA and local permit agencies

Qualifications

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

BA/BS + 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education with an emphasis on design

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience managing $5MM contract value projects
Bachelors of Science - Civil Engineering plus 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
Experience in preparation of Project Reports, Feasibility Studies, and PS&Es for Aviation projects
A proven track record of marketing/selling services to Aviation clients
Professional Engineer License in CA
Minimum of 8 years experience including 8 years of project management in the aviation market sector
Available to travel to clients and projects in Southern California Nevada and other states within the region

Additional Information

U.S. citizenship is required for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $150000 to $245000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

Job Description

Olsson provides multidisciplinary, preliminary, and construction design services for mixed-use, commercial, and residential land development projects, along with industrial, sports, schools, and other site development types. The project manager role serves as a lead project manager for the team, ensuring successful project deliverables and completion for complex and high-priority projects that may span across multiple teams. This position provides project management direction to the team and ensures quality execution of key projects that provide purposeful, high-quality solutions to successfully solve engineering and design needs.

Primary Responsibilities Include

Develops project scopes, schedules, and budgets and tracks progress to manage the financial success of projects and ensure timely completion.

Leads the execution of project plans by assembling and managing project teams, coordinating availability of internal resources, and assigning individual responsibilities ensuring technical skills, capabilities, and expertise align with project objectives.
Monitors progress and measures project performance, ensuring deliverables fall within established scope, schedule, and budget.
Manages change requests, executes risk management techniques, and implements strategies to minimize negative financial impact to the project.
Coordinates detailed reviews of technical work to ensure high-quality work is being performed and the terms, conditions, and specifications outlined in the project contract are being fulfilled.
Maintains an ongoing positive relationship with clients and focuses on exceptional client service to secure future work.
Documents all project deliverables and maintains comprehensive records including correspondence, design plans, and other project related files.
Mentors staff within the team on project management best practices utilizing Olsson Project Management programs and other project support services resources.

Olsson currently has growth opportunities for our Site Design group. This role offers flexible work options, including remote and hybrid opportunities, to accommodate diverse working preferences and promote work-life balance. Candidates can work hybrid schedules, work remotely, or work out of any Olsson office location in these regions/areas.

Applicants should have the ability to travel for in-office activities, client and site visits as needed.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

Working collaboratively with others.
Having ownership in the work you do.
Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You Bring To The Team

Strong communication skills
Ability to contribute and work well on a team
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
Project management experience including scope, schedule, and budget control
8+ years of experience in site design and development
Must be a registered Professional Engineer (PE)
Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D

Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

new_jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Company

At Builder Prime, we’re revolutionizing the home improvement industry by doing more than just building software—we're giving hardworking contractors their time and freedom back. Our all-in-one business management solution is the essential platform for companies at their "level-up" moment, seamlessly integrating CRM, estimating, production management, payments, and reporting. By replacing disjointed tools with a unified data and automation foundation, we empower businesses to operate more efficiently, win more jobs, and achieve their growth goals. We look for collaborative and community-oriented team members who bring initiative and curiosity to the challenge of solving problems for our customers.

Builder Prime is backed by Blueprint Equity and is an AI-forward company. That means every employee is expected to use AI on real problems—not hypotheticals, not demos, but the actual work on their desk. We invest in tools, training, and time for our team to experiment and share what they learn. We’re not waiting on the sidelines, and we don’t have it all figured out. We’re building this practice alongside our team, in the open.

We look for collaborative, community-oriented team members who bring initiative, curiosity, and a genuine interest in figuring out how AI can make their work and their customers’ outcomes better.

THE ROLE

This is a remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship, who presently reside in the US.
There is a preference for candidates in states where we already have Builder Prime employees; California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Nebraska, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin. Builder Prime has an office in the greater Denver metro area (Westminster) that some of the sales team works out of.

Our implementation team facilitates smooth transitions for new customers by providing personalized implementation plans, technical configuration assistance, and comprehensive training to ensure effective software adoption and swift time to value.

As a member of the implementation team, you will lead implementations and drive strategic improvements to our implementation methodology. You'll serve as the escalation point for challenging technical configurations and will be instrumental in reducing our overall customer onboarding timeline.

THE DAY-TO-DAY

As an Implementation Project Manager at Builder Prime, you are responsible for guiding new customers through the implementation process, ensuring they achieve rapid time-to-value from our platform. This role reports directly to the Manager of Implementation and collaborates closely with Account Managers, Support, and Sales.

Drive strategic initiatives to streamline implementation processes and reduce time-to-value
Manage implementations with multiple stakeholders and complex technical requirements
Lead kickoff calls to understand customer goals, timeline expectations, and success metrics
Configure the platform with custom templates, workflows, and settings specific to each customer's needs
Prepare customers for post-implementation self-sufficiency by delivering system training as part of the Implementation process.
Track implementation milestones and manage customer expectations throughout the setup process
Identify and solve technical challenges that arise during implementation
Coordinate with Account Managers for a smooth handoff once implementation is complete
Document customer workflows and configurations for future reference and support
Continuously optimize implementation processes to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction
Analyze implementation data to identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements
Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving customer onboarding experience

THE MUST-HAVES

3+ years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation, or training roles, preferably in SaaS or construction technology
Demonstrated ability to translate technical product capabilities into business value for diverse customer workflows
Proven track record of reducing implementation timelines and improving customer satisfaction scores
Experience with implementations involving multiple stakeholders and complex integrations
Strong analytical skills with ability to use data to drive process improvements
Experience conducting engaging virtual training sessions
Strong technical configuration skills with the ability to learn and master new software platforms quickly
Excellent project management abilities with a track record of meeting implementation deadlines
Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to adapt messaging to different learning styles

THE NICE-TO-HAVES

Knowledge or experience in SaaS and the home improvement industry.
Strong understanding of business management CRM software and its application in improving business processes.

The Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here:

Exceptional Health Coverage – We cover 95% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees (Aetna & Guardian), plus 50% for dependents
Strong Retirement Match – 401k with up to 4% company match that's immediately vested (no waiting period!)
Generous Time Off – 20 PTO days, 48 hours sick time, 9 paid holidays, plus a paid volunteer day to give back to your community
Annual International Retreat – All-expenses-paid company trip to connect with teammates in amazing destinations (This year we went to Cancun, Mexico! Join us for our next one in 2027)
Life Happens Coverage – Company-paid life insurance ($50k), AD&D, and short-term disability, plus optional accident, hospital, critical illness, and additional life insurance
Grow With Us – $300 annual professional development stipend, plus an incredible sabbatical at 5 years (2 extra weeks PTO + $1,000 travel bonus)
Comprehensive Parental Leave – 10 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing parents
Fully Equipped From Day One – Company-provided laptop and all the equipment you need to succeed

This position will pay a base salary of $65,000-$75,000 depending on experience and location.

Builder Prime is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at all levels. We also participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility in the U.S.

Compensation Range: $65K - $75K

new_jobs.title: IT Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Background

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As IT Program Manager
, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms (Fundraise Up, Springboard)
, our website (Drupal)
, Salesforce CRM
, Databricks
, email marketing (Pardot)
, and SMS platforms (Mobile Commons, Mogli)
. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

Why Join Us?

Real-world impact — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
Breadth and ownership — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
Collaborative culture — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
Modern delivery — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
Remote-first flexibility — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

What You'll Do

Drive end-to-end program delivery
Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

Champion Agile ways of working
Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

Keep stakeholders informed and aligned
Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

Manage budgets and vendors
Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

Lead business analysis activities
Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

Manage risk proactively
Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

Shape the roadmap
Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

What You'll Bring

You'll need:

3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

It'd Be Great If You Have

Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

Standard office working environment.

new_jobs.title: Transformation Project Manager, Payroll & Employee Lifecycle at ABB Robotics (Temporary role, 1 year)
new_jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Global Payroll Transformation and M&A Lead

Your Role And Responsibilities

As ABB Robotics prepares for an exciting new chapter as a standalone global leader in automation, we are undertaking a major transformation of our people processes and systems. To support this journey, we are looking for an experienced Transformation Project Manager
to lead payroll and employee lifecycle transformation initiatives across multiple countries.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future payroll landscape of a global organization during a period of significant change and growth. You will work in an international environment, collaborating with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, external partners, and senior stakeholders worldwide.

As Transformation Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end payroll transformation and implementation projects, ensuring successful delivery from discovery and design through deployment and stabilization. You will serve as a key partner to the Global Payroll Transformation Lead and work closely with both local and global stakeholders to establish future-ready payroll and employee lifecycle processes.

The position is a temporary assignment ending October 31, 2027
.

Location:
Flexible within Europe, with a preference for candidates located in Poland, Spain, or the Nordic countries.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Leading payroll and employee lifecycle transformation projects across multiple countries.
Driving local country discovery activities to understand current processes and define future-state solutions.
Managing project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
Coordinating with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation and integration.
Facilitating workshops, gathering business requirements, and supporting solution design.
Overseeing testing activities, payroll validations, and go-live readiness.
Supporting change management, training, and transition into operational support.
Ensuring compliance with local legislation, payroll regulations, and company policies.
Providing regular project updates and recommendations to senior leadership and program stakeholders.

Qualifications For The Role

Extensive project management experience within payroll, HR transformation, or shared services environments.
Fluency in English and Swedish.
Solid understanding of payroll operations, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience supporting organizations operating across Nordic countries.
Proven experience leading payroll implementation projects in complex, multinational organizations.
Strong experience with Workday, including payroll-related processes and integrations.
Experience with Strada, divestments, or carve-out projects is considered an advantage.
Experience working with global and cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and change management skills.
Willingness to travel occasionally for key workshops and project milestones.
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

More About Us

ABB Robotics is a global technology leader enabling customers to become more productive, flexible, and sustainable through automation. As we prepare to become an independent company, you will have the opportunity to contribute to one of the most exciting transformation journeys in our industry while working alongside highly skilled colleagues from across the world.

If you are motivated by driving change, building new ways of working, and delivering business-critical transformation projects, we look forward to hearing from you.

We look forward to receiving your application. Last day to apply is October 11.

We are a growing, dedicated team of financial professionals, mathematicians, financial engineers, software developers working together to transform the field of wealth management. We aim to make portfolio management frictionless, enabling every investor to benefit from levels of customization and tax management that were once the exclusive preserve of ultra-high net worth investors.

We are devoted to doing things right, bringing a fiduciary standard of care to all that we do.

Position Overview

As Smartleaf’s Implementation Project Manager
, you will play a critical role in onboarding new client firms, while serving as a subject matter expert and point of contact while providing our clients with a successful and delightful experience.

Your primary objective will be to drive high-impact enterprise onboarding, leading multi-million-dollar FinTech implementations from technical architecture to go-live. You will solve complex data integration, custodial API, and workflow automation challenges alongside financial engineers. You will balance Smartleaf and client objectives while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders and executing on a defined project plan.

Success in this role will lead to client implementations being completed on schedule and new clients extracting value from the system right away.

We strongly prefer candidates local to the Boston area. While office attendance is at the discretion of individual teams currently, we do find that onboarding and training greatly benefit from in-person interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

To be considered for this role, we will be looking for the following:

Education
: Bachelor's degree or higher in a related field required.

Experience
: 5+ years of experience with enterprise SaaS implementations or project management. Prior experience in Financial Services or FinTech and experience with enterprise clients, and high ARR clients is preferred.

Skills
: You are organized, a great communicator, able to multitask, can prioritize competing demands to manage your time and responsibilities well.

Characteristics
: You are self-sufficient and work well independently. You are also personable and relationship-oriented. You are comfortable working with internal and external stakeholders, including executives.

Trajectory
: You are eager to learn and looking for a job with room to grow.

Initial Responsibilities

Understand client requirements and objectives; translate into an actionable project plan
Manage the project lifecycle (sales to service transition, planning, execution, monitoring, closure)
Establish and maintain relationships with internal/external stakeholders
Partner with internal specialists to execute on the project plan
Set expectations of internal and external stakeholders; hold teams accountable for deadlines and deliverables
Continuously report on project status, including progress to plan and hours spent
Identify issues and mitigate risks; develop contingency plans as needed
Document lessons learned and recommend process improvements

Please note, responsibilities are fluid and can change based on team need. We are looking for a candidate who is adaptable, eager to lend a hand, willing to position themselves as an integral member of the Smartleaf organization, and eager to grow their personal skillset.

Core Benefits

Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance with 100% of premium and deductible covered for employees and family (copays apply)
SIMPLE IRA with 4% company match
Four weeks PTO + NYSE holidays
Flexible work-from-home policy

Work Style

If you are in-office...

Casual dress code
Beautiful office space within a 15-minute walk of 4 subway lines and commuter rail
Office shower for bike commuters
A stocked kitchen with breakfast and lunch options plus the opportunity to dazzle your coworkers with your barista skills (which is to say, we have an espresso machine!)

If you are remote...

All team meetings are by video conference
The team communicates throughout the day via messaging stream (akin to Slack), Google Meet, and Zoom
At present, some team members have chosen to be in the office a few days a week while the majority are currently remote

Visa Sponsorships

Smartleaf is unable to provide visa sponsorship now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to, H-1B, F-1 (including OPT/CPT), J-1, or any other employment-based immigration or work authorization sponsorship. Candidates must have current and ongoing authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Compensation Range: $100K - $135K

The Company

WE ARE ASQ: EXCELLENCE THROUGH QUALITY

ASQ is the leading membership association to help quality professionals achieve their career goals and drive excellence through quality in their organizations and industries. We provide expertise, knowledge, networks, and solutions to a global membership of individuals and organizations spanning more than 140 countries. ASQ was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

The Position

The Project Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional projects from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and business strategy. This role manages project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and stakeholder communications while supporting team governance and portfolio processes. The Project Manager drives operational improvements that enhance quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction, and collaborates with teams and individuals from both ASQ and its affiliate companies to deliver successful project outcomes.

The ideal candidate will be experienced in leading projects using predictive, adaptive, and hybrid methodologies, with a proven ability to facilitate cross-functional teams and drive results. PMP or equivalent certification and experience collaborating with global teams across multiple time zones is also a plus. Candidates must have excellent communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

The salary range for this role is $80,000 -$100,000/year. Any extended offer is based on the candidate's experience and overall fit for the role.

Main Responsibilities

Develops and executes project plans from initiation to closing, including budget management, schedule management, resource management, and end user management.
Develops and maintains project assets including schedules, risk management logs, decision logs, task tracking tools, dashboards, and automations to create real-time reporting tools.
Participates in PMO project selection, prioritization, governance, and risk management processes.
Works with functional managers to ensure that all required data for decision making is complete and available.

At Avnet, relationships matter. We are a global, FORTUNE ® 500 technology distributor and solutions company that delivers design, supply chain and logistics expertise to customers at every stage of a product’s lifecycle. Our employees have a front row seat to the latest innovations shaping the world we live in and the future we share. We’re driven to help our customers around the world succeed and we do so by earning the trust of some of the biggest names in technology.

Working at Avnet means being a part of a global team. We work collaboratively and with integrity, doing business the right way. For more than a century, we have partnered together to help our customers, suppliers and teammates realize the transformative possibilities of technology. Experience what’s next at Avnet!

Job Summary

Identifies opportunities for global business expansion in support of the customer offshore design and manufacturing. Develops and maintains the business relationship by providing solutions for the company and its defined supplier(s) in a product line, to achieve the identified strategy and business financial objectives. Planning and managing the migration of sales to meet product delivery, customer service, and revenue goals.

Principal Responsibilities

Provides value added solutions for the company and its defined supplier(s) growth plans and business.
Responsible for planning and managing programs/projects to meet product delivery, customer service and revenue goals.
Assist with coordinating sales and support team efforts in assigned accounts/territories/regions.
Reviews customer requirements, identifies tasks, assigns and coordinates resources and creates/tracks project schedules.
Ability to rapidly make prudent business decisions based on data analytics and craft sales and supply chain strategies.
Collaborating between global sales teams, support teams, internal and external stakeholders globally.
Responsible for the linkage between design and supply chains by connecting the design and fulfillment region resources and ensuring that design region resources are compensated based on pre-agreed norms.
Tracks outbound manufacturing migrations for the company's customers.
Gathering and documenting changes in such things as line card pricing, margins and revenue analysis.
Updates and maintains critical business information in a databases which serve as the migration information system.
Creates custom migration strategies for design region customers and executes based on set strategies.
Ensures inter-regional margin splits are reported by fulfillment region so that the company's design and fulfillment regions share return-on-investment.
Other duties as assigned.

Extensive knowledge and application of principles, theories and concepts. Complete knowledge of all job functions and the broad industry best practices, techniques and standards.
Develops solutions to complex problems where analysis of situations and/or data requires in-depth evaluation of variables. Determine best approach to achieve results and provide suggestions to improve policies and procedures.

Work Experience

Typically 5+ years with bachelor's or equivalent.

Bachelors degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

Our employees work hard to live our values and help us grow. Our total rewards strategy supports Avnet’s ability to attract, engage, develop, and reward our employees, while promoting a diverse and inclusive environment. WSP is proactively building its Aviation PM/CM team to support anticipated airport and airline opportunities, with an initial focus on Texas and Louisiana. We are seeking an experienced Lead Aviation Project Manager
who can serve in key project leadership roles as future assignments develop.

The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading complex capital projects, multidisciplinary teams, and client relationships, along with the flexibility and mobility to support assignments in different locations across the United States. This individual will help establish project delivery strategies, organize and lead teams, manage project performance, and support pursuits for future airport and airline assignments.

Aviation experience is strongly preferred; however, candidates with significant transportation or complex infrastructure experience and demonstrated transferable project leadership skills will also be considered.

Serve in lead project management roles on future airport and airline assignments, with an initial focus on opportunities in Texas and Louisiana.
Establish project delivery strategies and lead multidisciplinary teams through planning, design, construction, commissioning, closeout, or other phases based on assignment requirements.
Lead owner-side program management, project management, and construction management assignments as required by future opportunities.
Develop and manage project scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, risk strategies, and delivery plans.
Monitor project performance and provide clear reporting on schedule, budget, quality, risk, changes, and key delivery milestones.
Coordinate with airport authorities, airlines, contractors, consultants, regulatory agencies, and other project stakeholders.
Facilitate project meetings and maintain effective communication with clients, project teams, and senior leadership.

Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary projects and project teams.
Experience managing projects through design and/or construction.
Experience managing scope, schedule, budget, contracts, risk, staffing, change, and client relationships.

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and client-facing communication skills.

Professional Engineer (PE) license.

Aviation or airport capital project experience.
Experience with airport program management, project management, and/or construction management.
Knowledge of FAA requirements, airport design standards, and aviation project delivery processes.
Experience supporting Airport Capital Improvement Programs (ACIP).
Experience with airfield, terminal, landside, roadway, utility, facilities, or other complex airport infrastructure.
Experience working with major hub, medium-hub, or commercial service airports.
Familiarity with FAA grant processes and airport funding programs.
Established professional relationships within the Texas and/or Louisiana aviation market.

Job Title: Architectural Project Manager (Architecture)
Job Description

This role leads complex architectural projects from early design through construction completion. The Architectural Project Manager oversees client relationships, project financials, schedules, and staffing while coordinating multidisciplinary teams and consultants. The position ensures high design quality, rigorous documentation, and successful project delivery across civic, museum, convention center, commercial, and other building types.

Responsibilities

Lead architectural projects from concept design through construction administration, ensuring alignment with project goals, quality standards, and client expectations.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle, managing communication, expectations, and overall client satisfaction.
Manage project budgets, schedules, and staffing plans, and monitor financial performance to ensure projects meet profitability and performance targets.
Coordinate and oversee consultant teams, including engineering and specialty consultants, to ensure integrated, coordinated project delivery.
Lead contract negotiations and administer contracts with clients and consultants, ensuring compliance with scope, schedule, and budget requirements.
Ensure quality control and consistency of project documentation, including design development and construction documents, in accordance with office standards and industry best practices.
Oversee the preparation and review of construction documents, including drawings and specifications, to support accurate bidding and successful construction.
Direct and support construction administration activities, including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and participating in site observations.
Guide and support design development efforts to maintain design integrity while addressing technical, budgetary, and constructability considerations.
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams, fostering collaboration and clear communication among architects, designers, and consultants.
Support business development efforts by contributing to proposals, interviews, and client presentations, helping to secure new work and expand client relationships.
Mentor and develop junior staff, providing guidance, feedback, and opportunities for professional growth.
Apply knowledge of sustainability principles to inform design and project decisions, aligning with project and client goals.
Utilize project management tools and software to track schedules, budgets, and resources, and to report on project status to internal stakeholders.

Essential Skills

10+ years of architectural experience with progressively responsible roles on complex projects.
Proven architectural project management experience leading projects from design through construction.
Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, and financial performance.
Strong client management skills, including experience serving as primary client contact.
Experience coordinating and managing consultant teams, including multidisciplinary engineering and specialty consultants.
Proficiency in Revit for design, documentation, and coordination.
Experience with construction documents and construction administration processes.
Strong understanding of design development and architectural design processes.
Experience with commercial building projects and complex building types such as civic, museum, and convention center projects.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Bachelors degree in Architecture.
Proficiency with Excel for project financial tracking and reporting.
Experience with budget, schedule, and financial management in an architectural or related professional services environment.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience with Deltek Vantagepoint for project accounting and management is preferred.
Experience with Microsoft Project or similar scheduling tools is preferred.
Knowledge of sustainability principles and their application to architectural projects.
Experience with contract negotiation and contract administration for architectural projects.
Experience supporting business development, proposals, and client presentations.
Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills to effectively guide project teams and interact with clients and consultants.
Ability to mentor and develop junior staff, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.

Work Environment

The standard work schedule is 40 hours per week. Employees collaborate in the office on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to support teamwork, coordination, and mentoring. Fridays operate as a hybrid workday, allowing employees to work in the office, from home, or from another location of their choice. Core work hours are 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., providing flexibility for employees to structure their start and end times around personal commitments while ensuring overlap for meetings and collaboration. The work environment emphasizes professional collaboration, use of digital design and project management tools, and a balance of focused individual work and coordinated team efforts.

Job Type & Location

This is a Permanent position based out of Seattle, WA.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $120000.00 - $140000.00/yr.

About Us

The Women’s Housing and Economic Development Corporation (WHEDco) is a community development organization founded on the radically simple idea that all people deserve to live in healthy, vibrant communities. We build award-winning, sustainable, affordable homes – but our work is not over when our buildings are complete. WHEDco believes that to be successful, affordable housing must be anchored in strong communities of which residents can be proud. WHEDco’s mission is to create and bridge access in the South Bronx to resources that support thriving neighborhoods – from stable, affordable housing to high-quality early childhood and school-age youth education programs, comprehensive family and community services, business and entrepreneur assistance, and cultural programming. See www.whedco.org for more information.

Job Summary

The Project Manager (PM) supports WHEDco’s Housing and Real Estate Department by developing and managing construction projects at WHEDco’s three mixed-use properties from inception to completion. In coordination with the Director of Housing and Real Estate, the PM will identify and address building and programmatic needs, plan and execute capital work, and use financial and operational data to measure impact, in order to ensure long term physical and financial sustainability.

Responsibilities

Manage WHEDco’s capital projects, including new construction and renovations. Assist in securing funding, loan closings, pre-development, design, bidding, contract development, insurance review, budgeting, and construction project management and administration; Coordinate with residents and staff; Assist the Director of Housing and Real Estate with funding requisition processes and overall project tracking and reporting to funding agencies.
Serve as a point person for all of WHEDco facility maintenance needs and as a liaison among vendors, project teams, property management, residents, and WHEDco staff to ensure timely completion and achievement of project goals.
Coordinate and lead on-site and virtual project meetings. Maintain communication with consultants, design professionals, contractors, trades, funding agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget; Represent WHEDco in construction meetings led by property management or third-party consultants.
Manage utilities and energy performance across WHEDco’s three properties. Ensure compliance with local laws, the NYC Building Code, and energy benchmarking requirements; Monitor existing energy retrofit projects, including a combined heat and power (COGEN) system, monitor and manage other energy and water saving programs.
Manage emergency systems including fire alarm panels, central station monitoring, elevator calling, security, and camera monitoring; Use knowledge of building systems to provide support in the development and maintenance of emergency plans, fire safety plans, as well as business continuity plans for WHEDco’s programs and services.
Ensure WHEDco’s buildings are compliant with various funding and regulatory agencies; Support property management in monitoring and removing building violations, including ECB/OATH, DOB, FDNY, DOHMH, and HPD, and recommend operational changes to prevent compliance issues.
Support Asset Manager and Director of Housing and Real Estate in identifying issues impacting residents and WHEDco programs and develop capital plans and budgets to address these; Research, recommend, and implement capital projects that enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, and resiliency in WHEDco buildings; In coordination with the Asset Manager, evaluate returns on investment, and the financial and operational impact of work.
Engage residents, building maintenance, and WHEDco staff in recycling, waste reduction, and other sustainability practices that can reduce building operating expenses and improve quality of life for building residents and WHEDco clients.
Support the Asset Manager and Director of Housing and Real Estate with asset management and compliance projects as needed.
Maintain and organize critical asset documentation, including loan documents, insurance records, building plans, regulatory agreements, and capital project records.
Assist the Director of Housing and Real Estate with additional projects and strategic initiatives as needed.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in real estate development, property management, urban planning, business, or affordable housing. Master’s degree preferred but not required.
Minimum of two years of relevant professional experience in real estate, construction, property or facilities management, affordable housing, or a related field preferred.
Experience working in NYC preferred including familiarity with relevant agencies (e.g., DOB, FDNY, HPD, HDC, HRA) or experience in a role with direct agency coordination, compliance, or reporting.
Strong organizational skills, with keen attention to detail. Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and documentation is essential.
Strong project management, financial, and analytical skills.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, for developing and tracking budgets, and evaluation.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Proactive problem-solver and avid team player. Must have the ability to remain focused in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated commitment to affordable housing and serving low-income communities.

This is a full-time, exempt position. Excellent benefits and competitive salary based on experience. This is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of four days per week on-site at WHEDco properties or offices. The regular in-person workdays will be established by the Director of Housing and Real Estate and are expected to remain consistent from week to week, subject to business and operational needs. Additional in-person attendance may be required for contractor meetings, property inspections, project needs, or other on-site responsibilities. The position also requires availability on nights and weekends in the event of building or project emergencies.

new_jobs.title: Commercial Operations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager for a critical pillar of our Program Management function: Commercial Operations. This role will transform our commercial infrastructure into a revenue accelerator, building and executing the operational leverage that enables Anthropic to maintain velocity as we scale. You'll be responsible for managing and enhancing processes that support rapid product growth. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, someone who can both envision where we need to be in 12 months and build the infrastructure to get us there.

Responsibilities

Play a central role on the team that runs Anthropic's programs for Commercial Launches — helping evolve an established launch motion into a scalable, well-instrumented program that keeps pace with an accelerating product roadmap
Run launches end-to-end through the Commercial launch process: lead intake and scoping for your portfolio of launches, translate each into its commercial-readiness requirements (pricing, billing, tax, marketplace, compliance and selling motions), and collaborate with product teams to develop paths to launch
Identify where launches slow down today and drive resolution to prevent them from recurring: propose and implement process and system changes, clarify ownership, drive completion across partner teams like, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and GTM.
Build specific program components that don't exist yet — launch tiering, readiness criteria, playbooks, templates, SLAs; and develop training that shifts programs from late-stage gatekeeper to early-stage partner
Take ownership of major program-improvement workstreams such as instrumentation (pipeline visibility, readiness scorecards, guides, throughput and cycle-time metrics) or workflow tooling and automation (intake, tracking, approvals, status) in partnership with Engineering and systems teams
Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM teams to design clear interfaces and processes that span multiple teams

You may be a good fit if you have

Experience building and running new product introduction processes
10+ years of experience in operations, with demonstrated success in billing, payments, or commercial operations (high-volume SaaS experience a plus)
Strong working knowledge of billing systems, subscription management, and payments platforms
Proven track record of building and scaling operational programs in high-growth environments — taking things from 0-1 and then scaling beyond
Willing to roll up your sleeves and do the operational work of building while also leading a team
Experience with automation initiatives and partnering with engineering teams to build operational tooling
Strong analytical abilities, problem-solving skills, and the ability to demonstrate ROI on operational programs
Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across GTM, Finance, Product, and Engineering
Adaptability and comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where you need to balance multiple priorities simultaneously
Excitement about building the operational backbone that enables Anthropic to stay on the exponential

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$190,000—$190,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

new_jobs.title: Reading Corps Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Organizational Summary

Colorado Youth for a Change (CYC) is an educational nonprofit organization with a statewide scope. CYC addresses barriers to learning by providing individualized support throughout pivotal stages of students' education journeys. We provide a continuum of services from kindergarten through high school to help students find success through tutoring, case management, and outreach to help in-school youth remain in school or out-of-school youth return to school. We envision an equitable education system where each student has access to resources they need to maximize their own learning and growth. CYC’s organizational values are growth, integrity, community, and systemic transformation.

Program Overview

CYC began implementing Reading Corps in Colorado in 2017 to provide reading supports for kindergarten – 3rd grade students. Colorado Reading Corps is an AmeriCorps program with the mission of ensuring that all students in Colorado are reading proficiently by the end of third grade. The Reading Corps program combines the power of national service with literacy science to deliver proven approaches that help struggling learners transform into confident students – something that translates into all areas of their lives. The program is a licensed replication of a national, evidence-based model.

Position Summary

The Reading Corps Program Manager is responsible for cultivating a strong Reading Corps program culture that is fully integrated into CYC’s culture and identity. This position is the Reading Corps point person, both externally and internally. The Reading Corps Program Manager guides the direction of the program while ensuring the detailed nuances of Reading Corps funding and regulations are met with thoroughness and integrity at every step. The Reading Corps Program Manager is responsible for ensuring CYC/Reading Corps mission alignment; ensuring Reading Corps members have a meaningful service experience, supervising Reading Corps Coaching Specialists, coordinating and facilitating monthly member meetings, program reporting, and supporting the annual grant reapplication process. The Reading Corps Program Manager is responsible for ensuring successful partnerships with schools/districts, Ampact, and ServeCO. The chief duty in this position is to ensure CYC operates a successful Reading Corps program – investing in the systems and service culture for long-term growth, while ensuring 100% administrative compliance. This position is full-time with a salary of $65,000 annually with benefits. This hybrid position includes in-person responsibilities - primarily in the Denver metro area, with additional meetings in Weld/Larimer counties and communities throughout those regions.

Essential Functions

Member Support

Manage member onboarding, including communication with incoming members.
Communicate all program policies to members and ensure policies are followed with integrity.
Encourage a culture of service amongst members and reinforce Reading Corps identity.
Engage alumni and current members in recruitment efforts.
Develop and facilitate virtual member orientation, monthly program meetings and any applicable additional training/professional development throughout the service term.
Provide member resources and support around mental health.
Ensure Reading Corps Institute and RCLMS trainings and make ups throughout the year are implemented.

Personnel Management

Supervise, mentor, and support Reading Corps Coaching Specialists.
Provide ongoing professional development and training opportunities for Reading Corps Coaching Specialists.
Participate in national Program Manager calls to support Colorado Coaching Specialists.
Facilitate weekly team meetings.
With the assistance of Human Resources and agency Leadership, carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.

Program Management

Develop and maintain strong partnerships with stakeholders.
Ensure that all program goals are ontrack and that contracted goals are met.
Develop and manage tools and data systems to ensure effective program strategies.
Manage service site recruitment, including facilitating an Internal Coaches training, as well as ongoing service site communication, relationship building, and securing ongoing participation from one year to the next.
Liaise with Serve Colorado program officer and Ampact.
Attend Serve Colorado, Ampact, and Corporation for National Community Service trainings/events.
Continually improve and update comprehensive Reading Corps policies & procedures manual.
With the support of Reading Corps Coaching Specialists, consistently gather and report on programmatic data utilizing PowerBI and RCDMS.
In collaboration with Reading Corps Coaching Specialists, ensure successful completion of midyear and end of year member evaluations.
Ensure CYC and AmeriCorps branding and gear is visible across all sites.
Work collaboratively with other CYC Program Managers, CYC Recruitment team, Internal Coaches, and school staff to provide cohesive services among the programs.
Manage member timesheet information and ensure accurate tracking of member service hours.
Facilitate restorative conversations with staff, members, and sites as needed.
Support monitoring visits, audits, and communication with Serve Colorado and Ampact.
Support grant applications and donor requests for data and information about the program.

Commitment to Organizational Culture and Values

Commit to operate within a framework that centers CYC’s organizational values of growth, community, integrity, and systemic transformation. oActively participate on CYC’s management team providing input and support on the organization’s strategic direction.
Contribute to an inclusive and equitable work environment and provide inclusive and equitable services to the community. This includes demonstrating:
oA commitment to learn and engage in antioppression trainings and conversations; including a willingness to unpack personal biases and identities.
oThe ability to put antioppression framework into practice within specific role at CYC; including a willingness to interrupt systems of oppression to create more equitable, inclusive environments for staff, AmeriCorps members, and students.
oThe ability to cultivate inclusive and equitable relationships with students, staff, AmeriCorps members, and community members with varied identities and life experiences.
oA desire to share the organizational responsibility of creating an environment that supports antioppression accountability.
oSupport and evaluate your team to develop and meet goals around antioppression work.

Other Duties

Attend and participate in staff meetings and trainings.
Speak on behalf of the organization when appropriate.
Attend relevant community and school meetings and events.
Run errands as needed using personal transportation.
Perform other duties, responsibilities and special projects as assigned.
Support CYC fundraising and storytelling efforts when applicable.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Work independently and remain organized in multiple settings.
Experience with and dedication to engage students, AmeriCorps members, and staff across social identities and life experiences.
Computer skills in Microsoft Word and Excel with an emphasis on the ability to create spreadsheets and tables in order to capture data.
Work collaboratively with internal staff and external partners.
Contribute to a positive morale.
Support strategic thinking and direction of the organization.
Manage and supervise team to deliver highquality services while fostering organizational culture.
Find and stay informed about beneficial resources regarding reading curriculum throughout the state of Colorado.
A passionate and committed belief that students deserve access to quality education resources and support.
Appreciation of clear and appropriate boundaries with youth, AmeriCorps members, and staff.
Dependable transportation and being insurable as a driver on the auto liability policy of Colorado Youth for a Change.

Benefits

Three weeks of paid vacation per year
9 days of paid sick time per year
Paid winter and spring breaks every year
Employee premiums for medical and dental insurance paid by CYC
Retirement plan with CYC matching up to 3%
Company paid parking
Plus other great benefits!

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of relevant experience, that must include 2 years minimum of the following:
oProgram management experience.
oSupervisory experience. oFacilitation and training experience.
Literacy education experience preferred.
Experience working with AmeriCorps programs preferred.

We are accepting applications through 12:00 pm on October 16th.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Payments
new_jobs.description:
Description

Summary:

The Senior Project Manager - Payments will have deep domain expertise in payments to join our growing Payments team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional payments initiatives. You will serve as the connective tissue between product, technology, operations, risk, legal, and external partners, ensuring programs are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of rigorous project management methodology and hands-on payments knowledge — someone who can speak fluently about Payment networks in the same conversation as they manage a critical path schedule or escalate a risk to leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Lead end-to-end delivery of strategic payments programs, including product launches, platform migrations, FinTech integrations, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and status dashboards for executive and working-group audiences.
Drive project execution through structured agile/hybrid delivery frameworks, adapting methodology to fit the complexity and compliance requirements of payments projects.
Manage project budgets, resource planning, and vendor contracts in collaboration with Finance and Procurement.
Proactively identify schedule risks and develop mitigation strategies; escalate blockers with clear recommended paths to resolution.

Payments Domain Leadership

Apply deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem to shape project scope, anticipate integration challenges, and guide technical teams through payments-specific complexity.
Serve as the internal subject matter authority on payment rails and schemes including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, NACHA/ACH, RTP, FedNow, SWIFT, and emerging real-time networks.
Partner with Product and Technology to define acceptance criteria for payment flows, ensuring compliance with network rules, regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, Reg E, PSD2, NACHA Operating Rules), and security standards.
Champion best practices in payments security, fraud mitigation, tokenization, and authentication (3DS, biometrics) throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and external partners.
Facilitate and lead cross-functional steering committees, working groups, and executive readouts — distilling complex technical and regulatory issues into clear decisions and actions.
Produce high-quality written communications including project charters, executive briefings, business cases, and post-implementation reviews.
Act as the primary point of contact for third-party payment partners and vendors during integration and certification phases.

Process Improvement & Governance

Define and continuously improve PMO standards, playbooks, and governance frameworks specific to payments programs.
Conduct post-mortem reviews and embed lessons learned into future project planning and team capability building.
Support the development of junior project managers through mentorship, coaching, and structured knowledge sharing.
Contribute to strategic planning cycles by helping translate business objectives into executable roadmaps and investment cases.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree
7+ years of experience in project or program management, with at least 5+ years in a payments, fintech, or financial services environment.
5+ years of experience with project management tools such as Jira, Monday.com or something similar

Preferred Qualifications

Experience utilizing a variety portfolio project management tool and creating and tracking project schedules in MS Excel or MS Project
Strong understanding of project lifecycle methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Iterative, Agile/Scrum) and project management processes and standards
Strong aptitude in both business and technology
Excellent verbal and written communications skills; ability to explain project risks and issues, and IT related concepts clearly and concisely to multiple layers of peers and leadership
High motivated with strong organizational, analytical, decision making, and problem solving skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and to handle multiple priorities and effectively prioritize them
Ability to provide strong program and project leadership during periods of uncertainty, ambiguity, and change
Willingness and drive to learn and understand detailed software solutions
High level of professionalism and confidence with the ability to build credibility with leadership, team members, and business partners and establish effective working relationships
Ability to initiate and facilitate change, whether indicated by corporate needs, market or regulatory requirements
Experience leading large, cross-functional information technology programs and projects

Yes

Our Approach to Office
Workplace Type

Certain positions outside our branch network may be eligible for a flexible work arrangement. We’re combining the best of both worlds: in-office and work from home. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. Remote roles will also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for moments that matter. Specific work arrangements will be provided by the hiring team.
